description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
"Our pastor started teaching prophecies and other teachings like the existence of demons from the books of Jasper and Enoch.
He reiterated that since the bible in the book of Joshua mentions the book of Jasper then it's enough proof for us to quote from them and believe in them. (Joshua 10:13)
Kindly talk about these books and what role they play in our church."
.
Jesus and EGW both state that some of the remnants will be working when He returns. It would be nice to have your thoughts on this as it is an aspect that is not discussed.
.
Who are these 10 kings which receive not yet the kingdom? and when will they receive the kingdom?
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
